SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. SPECIAL BRANCH File No. D 5629 Copy No. 134）
Date January 30, 1934.
Subject (in full) Room 344, Continental Emporium Building, 229 Nanking Road.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D. G. Somervell.

In compliance with the instructions of the Officer
i/c Special Branch, a discreet watch over a period of three
days was kept by the Chinese staff of this Section on the
offices of the Lien Dah Development Co. (联达公司), Room 344,
Continental Emporium Building, 229 Nanking Road. Nothing
of any police interest was observed.

The individuals connected with the Room No. 344
as mentioned in report dated January 25, 1934, have been recorded
for future reference.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（印：O.C. S.B.）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处 特务科 档案号 D 5629 副本号 134）
日期：1934年1月30日。
事由（全称）：南京路229号大陆商场大楼344室。
制作人：督察 顾宝华 转呈人：D. G. Somervell。

遵照特务科主管官员的指示，本科华员对位于南京路229号大陆商场大楼344室的联达公司（Lien Dah Development Co.）办事处进行了为期三天的秘密监视。未观察到任何具有警务价值的情况。

与1934年1月25日报告中提及的344室有关的人员已记录在案，以备日后查考。

顾宝华
督察

特务科主管官员。

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C & S.B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5629
Date 22/1/34）

Date January 22, 1934.

Subject (in full) Room 344, Continental Emporium Building, 229 Nanking Road.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by D.I [签名]

With reference to the attached report from the Shanghai
Bureau of Public Safety regarding Room 344, Continental Emporium
Building, No.229 Nanking Road, which is stated to be rented by a
communist named Chang Pah-yu (張伯裕) who is at present in the
custody of the Chinese Authorities, I have to report the following
result of enquiries made by the Chinese staff of this office :-

It has been ascertained that Chang Pah-yu was connected
with a Chinese export and import business known as the Far Eastern
Trading Co., which occupied Office No.344, Continental Emporium
Building, No.229 Nanking Road, between April 16 and December 31,
1933. The lease was signed by one Ching Zay Yen(程載彥) and
was guaranteed by the Dah Kiang(大江) Bookstore, No.3, Lane 177,
Tsepoo Road.

It is of interest to note that the Dah Kiang Bookstore
was visited by the Municipal Police on December 7, 1933, on the
authority of a warrant issued at the instance of the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau. A quantity of pro-communist books and
printing matrices were seized but no arrests were made.

Since January 1, 1934, the office in question has been
rented by the Lien Dah Development Co.(聯達公司). This firm
is believed to deal in motor car accessories and radio apparatus
and is conducted by the following individuals whose names appear
on the lease which is guaranteed by the Kwan Tung Industrial Works
(關東實業工廠), Nos 79/80 Lao Kung Yih Li(老公益里), Jessfield :-

1) Choong Ching Daung(鐘靖東), who claims to be employed
with the International Radio Administration, Chenju. (description
unavailable).

2) Li Pah Zien(李百全), who is described to be about
32 years of age, native of Chekiang, height 5'7", slim build,

日期 1934年1月22日）

日期：1934年1月22日。

事由（全称）：南京路229号大陆商场大楼344室。

制作人：督察 顾宝华 转呈人：督察 [签名]

关于附上的上海市公安局有关南京路229号大陆商场大楼344室的报告，该室据称由一名名为张伯裕（Chang Pah-yu）的共产党员租用，此人目前正由中国当局羁押，兹就本办公室华员调查结果报告如下：

经查实，张伯裕曾与一家名为远东贸易公司（Far Eastern Trading Co.）的中国进出口商行有关联，该公司于1933年4月16日至12月31日期间占用南京路229号大陆商场大楼344号办公室。租约由程載彥（Ching Zay Yen）签署，并由泽浦路177弄3号的大江书店（Dah Kiang Bookstore）担保。

值得注意的是，工部局警务处曾于1933年12月7日凭上海市公安局申请签发的搜查令搜查了大江书店。当时查获了大量亲共书籍及印刷模版，但未实施逮捕。

自1934年1月1日起，上述办公室已由联达公司（Lien Dah Development Co.）租用。据信该公司经营汽车配件及无线电设备，由下列人员经营，其姓名出现在租约上，该租约由杰斯菲尔德老公益里79/80号的关东实业工厂（Kwan Tung Industrial Works）担保：

1) 钟靖东（Choong Ching Daung），自称受雇于镇江国际无线电管理局。（外貌特征不详）。

2) 李百全（Li Pah Zien），据描述年龄约32岁，浙江籍，身高5英尺7英寸，身材瘦削，

（批注：档案

Discreet enquiries show that Chang Pah-yu acted as the
intermediary for the renting of office No. 344 by the Lien Dah
Development Co. and the taking over of certain furniture left
therein by the defunct Far Eastern Trading Co. It is therefore
surmised that the new firm is either the successor or is
connected with the defunct Far Eastern Trading Co.
Although these firms appear to be of the mushroom type,
it is difficult to say with any certainty that they are financed
by the Chinese Communist Party, especially in view of the fact
that the person responsible for the enterprise - Chang Pah-yu -
is being detained by the Chinese Authorities.

经秘密调查得知，张伯裕充当了联达公司租用344号办公室以及接收已倒闭的远东贸易公司遗留在内的某些家具的中间人。因此推测，这家新公司要么是远东贸易公司的继任者，要么与其有关联。
尽管这些公司看似如雨后春笋般迅速成立又迅速消失的类型，但很难确切断定它们是由中国共产党资助的，特别是考虑到该企业负责人——张伯裕——正被中国当局拘留这一事实。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5629.
Date 15-1-1-34

At 12 noon, January 14, 1934, a communist
named Chang Pah-yu (張伯愚) responsible for communist
activities in the Chinan University was arrested at
No.948 Chenju Railway Station Road. Once he established
a food shop at Chenju but had absconded to Shanghai since
the arrest of a large number of reactionaries in the
Chinan University. Yesterday, he again arranged with
reactionaries of that location for the holding of a
meeting. This arrangement came to the knowledge of
local Kuomintang at whose instance the Public Safety
Bureau put him under arrest and seized his name card
on his person. According to report received, this
prisoner was responsible to the Communist Party for the
establishment of shops, and it is learned that he had
established a certain company at Room 344 Continental
Emporium Building although it is not known whether this
company is financed by the Communist Party or not.
At 10 p.m. the same day, three of his
associates named Hu Hao (胡灝), Ho Ping-dz (何東)
and Huang Chi-tsz (汪季子) were arrested behind the
Great China University when a large quantity of
communistic literature was seized.

Office i/c S.R.
Above report received from PSB
is forwarded for your information.
Van

8/2
SR

编号 D 5629。
日期 1934年1月15日

1934年1月14日中午12时，一名负责暨南大学共产主义活动的共产党员张伯愚（Chang Pah-yu）在真茹火车站路948号被捕。他曾在真茹开设一家食品店，但自暨南大学大批反动派被捕后逃至上海。昨日，他又与该地的反动派安排举行会议。此安排被当地国民党获悉，在其要求下，公安局将其逮捕，并搜出其随身携带的名片。据收到的报告称，该囚犯在共产党内负责建立店铺事宜，据悉他曾在大陆商场大楼344室设立某家公司，但尚不知该公司是否由共产党资助。
同日晚上10时，他的三名同伙胡灝（Hu Hao）、何东（Ho Ping-dz）和汪季子（Huang Chi-tsz）在大夏大学后面被捕，当时查获了大量共产主义文献。

特别报告办公室主管
以上来自公安局的报告
现转呈供您知悉。
Van

8/2
SR
